evidence.description: Log statement is outside the queue.async barrier block.
Log statement is outside the queue.async barrier block.

candidates.explanation: The logging statements in the registration and unregistration methods occur outside the barrier block. This can lead to race conditions or inconsistent log ordering where the log message might appear before the actual state change is committed to the set.
candidates.title: Race Condition in Logging

evidence.description: Use of [weak self] on a singleton instance.
Use of [weak self] on a singleton instance.
Use of [weak self] on a singleton instance.

candidates.explanation: The use of [weak self] inside a queue.async block on a singleton instance is unnecessary and potentially problematic. Since 'shared' is a static constant, the registry instance will never be deallocated, making the weak reference redundant and potentially causing the operation to be skipped if the compiler/runtime handles the weak reference unexpectedly.
candidates.title: Unnecessary Weak Reference on Singleton
